stages.suspectMessage: You have excellent taste in profiles. What brought you onto the app?

responseOptions.playerText: I’m looking for good conversation first.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Same here. I’m usually out photographing old buildings on weekends.

responseOptions.playerText: A friend insisted I give it a chance.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Friends are persuasive. Mine keeps trying to set me up at bookshops.

stages.suspectMessage: I’m planning a walk along the canal this Saturday. Do you get out much?

responseOptions.suspectReply: Fair. I’ll take grey skies over crowds any day.

responseOptions.playerText: I prefer places with a little noise.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Then I know a small cafe that gets wonderfully chaotic.

stages.suspectMessage: What makes someone trustworthy to you?

responseOptions.playerText: When their small stories stay consistent.
responseOptions.suspectReply: That’s a thoughtful answer. I think kindness is the better test, though.

responseOptions.playerText: When they can laugh at themselves.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Good rule. I’ve broken enough tripods to qualify.

stages.suspectMessage: I’m between shifts, so forgive the late reply. What does your perfect Sunday look like?

responseOptions.playerText: A long breakfast and no schedule.
responseOptions.suspectReply: That sounds luxurious. I’m usually awake before the alarm.

responseOptions.playerText: A new place and a good playlist.
responseOptions.suspectReply: I know a record shop with a very opinionated owner.

stages.suspectMessage: I moved around a lot for work. Have you ever lived somewhere unfamiliar?

responseOptions.playerText: Yes, but I always miss home.
responseOptions.suspectReply: The first winter is always the hardest part.

responseOptions.playerText: Not for long. I like familiar streets.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Then I’ll show you the streets I’ve learned.

stages.suspectMessage: People think my hours are strange. I just like having daylight to myself.

responseOptions.suspectReply: Exactly. No meetings, fewer opinions.

responseOptions.playerText: That sounds like a hard routine.
responseOptions.suspectReply: It is sometimes, but the quiet is worth it.

stages.suspectMessage: Your profile says you like honest answers. I’ll try not to disappoint. What are you curious about?

responseOptions.playerText: What people do when nobody is watching.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Usually laundry. I hope that is not too revealing.

responseOptions.playerText: Where you go when you need to think.
responseOptions.suspectReply: The hill above town. You can see every road from there.

stages.suspectMessage: I’ve never really spent time outside Bavaria, except for one quick conference in Berlin.

responseOptions.playerText: Berlin is a memorable conference city.
responseOptions.suspectReply: It was mostly fluorescent lights and bad coffee, honestly.

responseOptions.playerText: I’ve heard the museums are good.
responseOptions.suspectReply: I only saw the airport and the hotel. I can’t recommend either.

stages.suspectMessage: What would make you leave a date immediately?

responseOptions.suspectReply: Then I’d better remember this one.
That is a good boundary. I’ve got a few of my own.

stages.suspectMessage: I’m told my dog has more charisma than I do. What wins you over?

responseOptions.suspectReply: I can offer dad jokes and one excellent impression of a pigeon.
Then you’ll notice the dog has stolen my sock again.

stages.suspectMessage: I took a short trip recently, though I mostly stayed near the hotel.

responseOptions.playerText: Sometimes that is the best way to travel.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Exactly. A quiet room and a new breakfast menu.
I explored the hotel vending machine. It was an adventure.

stages.suspectMessage: Do you trust people quickly?

responseOptions.suspectReply: That sounds like a sensible pace.

responseOptions.playerText: I try to give everyone a chance.
responseOptions.suspectReply: The dog approves of that policy.

stages.suspectMessage: I’m usually buried in a project. What keeps you busy?

responseOptions.suspectReply: That can be the most demanding project.
I’m learning to cook without instructions. Mixed results.

stages.suspectMessage: Someone once called me secretive. I prefer private. There’s a difference.

responseOptions.suspectReply: Thank you. Most people hear one quiet answer and invent the rest.
Nothing dramatic. Just an unfinished novel and terrible singing.

stages.suspectMessage: What is something you would never do again?

responseOptions.playerText: Pretend to enjoy a bad first date.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Then we’ll both be honest if this turns strange.

responseOptions.playerText: Book a red-eye before a workday.
responseOptions.suspectReply: A mistake I have repeated with impressive consistency.

stages.suspectMessage: The best dates involve food. Are you adventurous with menus?

responseOptions.suspectReply: Brave. I know a tiny place with a menu that changes daily.

responseOptions.playerText: I’m loyal to a few favorites.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Reliable choices have their own charm.

stages.suspectMessage: My profile photo was taken by the river, just before the rain.

responseOptions.suspectReply: That is what I liked about it too.
The rain was trying to ruin the mood.

stages.suspectMessage: What do people misunderstand about you?

responseOptions.playerText: That I need more time than I do.
responseOptions.suspectReply: I understand that. People rush the quiet parts.

responseOptions.playerText: That I am always as confident as I look.
responseOptions.suspectReply: A surprisingly common disguise.

stages.suspectMessage: You seem observant. What caught your attention first?

responseOptions.suspectReply: I like places where conversations can breathe.
That one was taken on a work trip. The light was perfect.

stages.suspectMessage: I’m often travelling for work, but I haven’t been to Berlin in years. Not since university.

responseOptions.suspectReply: So I hear. I prefer smaller places now.
Urban planning. Mostly maps, models, and too much coffee.

stages.suspectMessage: I saw a photo you liked from Berlin. Have you been recently?

responseOptions.suspectReply: Ah. Then perhaps I confused the riverfront with somewhere else. Easy mistake.
That explains it. I thought I recognized a street behind you.

stages.suspectMessage: Do you believe people can reinvent themselves?

responseOptions.suspectReply: Honesty is the difficult part.

responseOptions.playerText: I think people mostly reveal themselves.
responseOptions.suspectReply: That is a slightly terrifying answer.

stages.suspectMessage: I collect old maps, though I rarely follow them anywhere.

responseOptions.suspectReply: Exactly. Every blank space feels like an invitation.
Only in museums and supermarkets.

stages.suspectMessage: What is your ideal first date?

responseOptions.playerText: A walk and an easy conversation.
responseOptions.suspectReply: That sounds hard to improve on.
I know exactly two of those.

stages.suspectMessage: I’m better in person than in a profile, supposedly. What is your tell?

responseOptions.playerText: I over-explain when I am nervous.
responseOptions.suspectReply: That makes two of us, though I under-explain first.
Useful. I am full of very ordinary answers.

stages.suspectMessage: I’ve never left Germany, but I’m saving for a long train trip.

responseOptions.suspectReply: Somewhere with mountains and a station cafe.

responseOptions.playerText: That sounds like a good project.
responseOptions.suspectReply: It gives me something to look forward to.

stages.suspectMessage: What makes you trust somebody?

responseOptions.suspectReply: A patient answer. I like it.

responseOptions.playerText: When they make room for mistakes.
responseOptions.suspectReply: Nobody gets through life without a few.

stages.suspectMessage: I have a theory that the best stories start with a wrong turn. Any good ones?

responseOptions.playerText: I once missed a train and found a great bakery.
responseOptions.suspectReply: That is a very good wrong turn.
Then I’ll suggest one small detour.

stages.suspectMessage: My hours are irregular because I work with emergency callouts.

responseOptions.suspectReply: It can be. The quiet days help.

responseOptions.playerText: Do you ever get used to it?
responseOptions.suspectReply: You get used to being ready, not to the calls.

stages.suspectMessage: What is something people misunderstand about you?

responseOptions.suspectReply: Exactly. Calm is often just careful breathing.
Sometimes, but not tonight.
